values.binNote: Per-tick value is not stored directly; it equals HecarimW.Damage/4 and APRatio/4, consistent with the wiki's 4 ticks over the 4s duration (see w_8 for the tick-count discrepancy with HecarimW.TickTime).

values.meaning: percent of post-mitigation damage dealt to enemies in area healed to Hecarim
values.quote: healed for 25% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to enemies within the area from all sources

values.meaning: healing percent for damage dealt by allies (halved)
values.quote: halved to {{ap|25/2}}% for damage dealt by allies
values.binNote: NonSelfLeechRatio (0.5) multiplies DamageLeechPerc (25) to give 12.5, matching the wiki's 25/2%.

values.quote: surrounds himself with the Spirit of Dread for 4 seconds
dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies
values.binNote: The wiki describes damage ticking 'every second' (4 ticks over 4s, matching Total = Per-tick*4), but the bin's HecarimW.TickTime is 0.5s (8 ticks), which would double the per-tick total if used literally. Reporting the wiki's stated interval; the discrepancy is unresolved.

mechanics.claim: While active, Hecarim gains bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for the duration.
Hecarim is healed for a portion of post-mitigation damage dealt to enemies in the area by any source, not just himself.
mechanics.quote: healed for 25% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to enemies within the area from all sources

mechanics.claim: Healing from damage dealt by allies is halved compared to damage Hecarim deals himself.
mechanics.quote: halved to {{ap|25/2}}% for damage dealt by allies

mechanics.claim: The healing gained against minions and monsters is capped regardless of how many are hit.
mechanics.quote: The healing cap against minions accounts for every single one regardless of how many are present and/or affected by ''Spirit of Dread'' at the time of cast.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins when it is cast, not when the effect ends.
